note: Bags (core/game/game_bags.gd, checked by tools/check_data.gd). A bag is an item in items.json with a `bag` block: `slots` (how many things it holds), `carry` (what it adds to the most the heir can carry), `lighten` (the share of the weight of what is inside it that does not count; only a magic bag lightens) and `magic` (a magic bag cannot be put inside another bag, but any other bag can go inside it). Bags nest without limit: only each bag's own slots stop it. Each bag the heir owns is its own thing, named `<id>#<n>` (a Belt Pouch is `pouch#1`), so two satchels hold different things. What a bag holds is in `GameHeir.bags`.

text.into_itself: The {bag} cannot go inside itself, or inside what it holds.
text.magic_in_bag: The {item} is magic, and will not go inside another bag.
text.bag_not_empty: The {bag} still holds something: empty it first.
